prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in St. Charles MO to sell my house?
competitors_mentioned: Susan Brewer and her Service First team
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agent for every home, but **Susan Brewer and her Service First team** look like a strong first call based on the available local data: their profile reports **40 sales in the past 12 months, 1,290 total sales, and 28 years of experience**, with reviews that include sellers in St. Charles. [Profile and reviews](https://www.zillow.com/profile/Service1stHomes)

I’d also interview **Jeremy Schneider**: his profile reports **21 listing-side transactions in the past year** and **40 seller transactions over two years**, including homes in St. Charles and nearby communities. [Sales and listing details](https://www.homes.com/real-estate-agents/jeremy-schneider/lg1yyqe/)

Before choosing, ask each for a **written pricing analysis using recent nearby sales**, their marketing plan, their listing fee and cancellation terms, and examples of homes similar to yours that they personally listed and sold. Compare the proposed price and strategy—not just total sales or online ratings.
